title: Safe and fun!
text: Excellent experience. Harry is very experienced, knowledgable, and kind. We felt safe and had fun the whole time. Can’t recommend enough!
author: B8749HMmelindad

title: A fantastic guide in a fun and photogenic spot
text: We had a fantastic time with Harry.  The hike was easy enough but made more exciting (and photogenic) by the hanging bridges, narrow passages and rock wall handholds.  The cave climb and rappelling was an adrenaline rush for sure, but Harry was an excellent instructor, making us all feel perfectly safe.  The snacks at the end, some fantastic photos Harry shared, and stories from his really interesting life were icing on the cake.  We 100% recommend this activity (or any other activity with Harry - he guides other places in the region too).
author: travelbug001_11

title: Magical!
text: This is a must-do, and is unlike any other adventure activity. We all loved it, including our 14 and 16 year old boys who were particularly impressed with the sunset picnic at the end. It was breathtaking, something we’ll never forget. The whole tour felt very personal and the attention to detail was great. The surroundings are beautiful, the activities just difficult enough to take you out of your comfort zone, and Harry and Maria are excellent guides. We will definitely use Dim Trap again and recommend to all of our friends. Thank you for an unforgettable experience!!
author: cj072

title: An amazing Day
text: Harry was polite, calm and confident. he guided us through the journey step by step, and made a lot easy for us. It was an awesome experience.
author: Mohammad T

title: 💯 worth it!! 10/10 would do again!
text: What an amazing experience! Harry was an excellent guide, and able to customize the experience for varying levels of experience. We hiked, climbed, repelled, went spelunking, and climbed down a waterfall! Harry brought snacks, water, and prepared lunch with a lovely mountainside view. Harry is very experienced, and it was definitely worth the trip!
author: bradsX4731GW

title: Great day with Harry
text: It was great to get out of the city and spend part of our day with Harry!  We did hiking & canyoning and had a blast.  Harry was great at tailoring our time to our abilities and we had the utmost confidence in his expertise & attention to safety.  We ended the tour with a wonderful picnic lunch and fantastic views.  We also received over 30 pictures that Harry took of our adventures.  Highly recommend Dim Trap!!
author: nancykZ3955DV

title: Amazing climbing adventure in beautiful Spa nish nature with super friendly and competent guide
text: My partner and I had the most amazing adventure with Harry. We are keen climbers and Harry adapted the day to suit our abilities. We climbed, caved and repelled the day away. He was very knowledgable, competent and friendly. He made sure we were safe and happy throughout. The picnic at the end was delicious (Thank you to Harry's wife) and the option of a glass of wine or iced tea was a lovely touch. We would 100% recommend Harry to anyone who is looking for an adventure in beautiful Spanish nature.
author: ameliab648

title: Multi adventure in Los Cahorros
text: Amazing afternoon with Harry who was a fantastic guide and very knowledgeable about los cahorros. The activities were really good fun and everything was included in the price. I could not recommend this more!
author: 703olliec

text: Absolutely amazing - Harry was definitely the best guide I’ve ever had. Everything was provided and definitely worth the money. If I could give more than 5 stars I would
author: Cartwright_O

title: A fun adventure with a great guide, only a short ride from the centre of Granada
text: We had a great trip! Harry is an excellent and knowledgeable guide who collected us from our hotel, took us through a picturesque canyon and provided a delicious lunch towards the end of our adventure…we climbed through a cave and abseiled back down over the water. The girls were v proud to have made a tricky climb up the side of the canyon too! Can thoroughly recommend!!
author: SueH229
